title: Grade 2 Math — Measuring and Comparing Lengths
subject: Math
description: Practice with questions on inches, centimeters, rulers, distance.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: A crayon is 8 cm long. A pen is 13 cm long. How much longer is the pen, in cm?
A book begins at 2 inches on a ruler and ends at 9 inches. How long is it, in inches?
A table is 70 cm wide. A desk is 62 cm wide. Find the difference, in cm.
Two 9-inch strips touch end to end. How long are they together, in inches?
A ribbon is 26 inches long. You cut away 11 inches. How many inches are left?
One toy cricket is 2 cm long. Another is 6 cm long. What is their total length, in cm?
There are 25 cm of tape. A label needs 10 cm. How many cm of tape remain?
A pencil lines up with 0 on a ruler and ends at 14. What is its length, in ruler units?
A worm starts at the 3 cm mark and ends at the 9 cm mark. How long is it?
A 10-inch bar is 3 inches longer than a stick. How long is the stick, in inches?
Estimate the total length of two toy trains that are each about 20 cm long.
Gus measured 19 cm from the window to the hook. The shelf is 7 cm farther along the wall. How far from the window is the shelf?
A board is 36 inches long. Paint covers the first 20 inches. How many inches still need paint?
A toy car is 11 cm long. An eraser is 5 cm long. How long are they together, in cm?
Tess needs 50 cm of yarn and has 38 cm. How many more cm does Tess need?
One trail segment is 42 meters. The next is 28 meters. Find their combined length in meters.
Three 5-inch strips are placed end to end. How far do they reach, in inches?
How many 10 cm pieces can be cut from a 40 cm cord without waste?
A stem grew from 7 cm to 12 cm. How many cm did it grow?
A 17-inch bag must fit in a 15-inch gap. How many inches too long is the bag?
